name: Chachya Open Rotary Edition 2018

venue.name: Le Palace Hotel Sousse
venue.details: Look for the conference room inside the hotel

information:
Chachya Open Rotary Edition 2018 is open for participants from all countries, everyone is welcome.
Competition fee is 60DT per participant
Medals and Gifts will be awarded to the winners in each category.
All competitors will be awarded a free cube. A coffee break will be held during the day (with food xD) and the rest of the particpation fee will be given to the Rotary Club to finance their humanitarian actions.
